description: Run one paid data capability (company data, people and contact data and the like) through Ahel's provider execution: it is quoted, the exact price is reserved from the workspace balance, and the run starts. Give id, a task id or tool id from capability_search: it runs only through the v2 capability Ahel's task map binds to it, and an item that is not ready is refused with its exact reason before anything is quoted. It then waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, at most 50; 0 answers at once): when the run finishes in that time, this same answer has its state, exact cost and rows, and generated images and audio as links; otherwise it answers the execution id, and capability_run_status reads the run. Data collection only: a capability that writes or has a side effect is refused. Ahel picks the provider unless endpoint_ids pins one; exclude_endpoint_ids leaves providers out. Give idempotency_key so a retry after a lost answer is safe: the same key answers the same run, with no new charge. Give tag (such as a customer name) to see usage and cost by tag in Activity. NOT for: the team's own tools, which is my_tools.

capability_id.description: Instead of id: a v2 capability id from capability_run_status (no execution_id).

endpoint_ids.description: Optional: run only on these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists. Leave it out to let Ahel pick (the default).

exclude_endpoint_ids.description: Optional: never use these providers, by the endpoint ids capability_inspect lists. Ahel picks among the rest.

id.description: A task id or tool id from capability_search or capability_inspect.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: your own key for this run, 8 to 200 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. Sending the same call again with the same key answers the same run with no new charge; the same key with different inputs is refused.

tag.description: Optional: a label for this run, such as the customer or project it is for: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Activity shows runs and cost by tag. It stays in Ahel and is never sent to a provider.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest the run may take, 1-180 seconds. Default: the provider's own (60, more for slow sources).

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait for the run to finish and answer its rows here, 0-50 seconds. Default 20; 0 answers the execution id at once.

name: run_capability
title: Run a paid data task
